policy.selection: Minimum inner-validation mean log loss; ties prefer larger ridge; refit all184 development cases
policy.primaryComparison: Paired AUC minus the identical neutral peak-index feature
policy.secondaryComparison: Paired AUC minus native layer baseline
policy.inputScope: ERA5/EAC4 retrospective feature reconstruction; provider transfer to operational GFS/ECMWF remains separate
policy.labelScope: Preserve source-only zeros, linked/source-only positives and missing source records. Calibrated real-world probability requires verified observation coverage.
policy.productionPolicy: Keep section-optics0.3.1 through this study; no production promotion from source-label fit alone
